_provenance.note: A forced non-zero exit cannot be recorded from a successful call — hand-authored to exercise runJson's non-zero-exit throw path (exec.mjs:31-32). Neither provider wraps commitStatus's runJson call, so a transport failure REJECTS — PINNED as out-of-scope (the mrList rationale, design D2), not because a caller depends on the throw (issue #385, M10 Phase 2 final Gap-A batch).
